title: CHEAP RACECAR BATTLE! Who Bought The Best Race Car Under $7,500?

event.name: Sick Week 2025 (drag-and-drive, 5 days, track to track, averaged ET); starts at South Georgia Motorsports Park; streamed on Freedom Plus

rules.fact: Winner = fastest average over the week
Parts at fair market value; team labor (e.g. fabrication) is free and not added
No working on the cars until day one of Sick Week (Monday / tech day); Zach+Ty started at 3:46 a.m. on day one and built a turbo kit off-car beforehand (gray area)
'Phoning a friend' to source a car joked as a $1,000 fine (Zach+Ty bought via a friend at auction)
Other people working on your car questioned as disallowed on drag-and-drives

teams.team: Mr. Sam (support, drives F-150 with tools/engine hoist)

targets.fact: Cleetus hopes someone runs a 9-second pass

cars.nickname: Woody (wood-panel sides); possibly the car later called 'Lumberjack' (not stated here)

base_vehicle.condition: rust on every panel, previous owner Kyle (with daughter Alissa) did two drag-and-drives on it, never trailered; stock suspension; lifts left front

purchase.breakdown: would have been $5,000; +$350 for ARP head studs the seller installed while reassembling (with new head gaskets)
purchase.seller: Kyle (bought the car for $250 as scrapyard rescue)

engine.rotating_assembly: stock rods and pistons, rings not re-gapped

power_adder.previous: 7675 with 0.96 hot side (brand not stated) (a Cleetus giveaway turbo) - sold before purchase; car bought with turbo kit but no turbo
power_adder.installed: Precision 7675 (remanufactured), T4 flange, 1.15 divided turbine housing, bought at event

fuel.type: E85 / flex fuel (flex-fuel sensor fitted); runs pump gas originally

transmission.type: 4L80E from an Express van (junkyard), shift kit
transmission.shifter: aftermarket shifter (opponent says ~$1,000 'operator' shifter) with doorbell-style two-step button

launch.method: foot-brake against two-step up to ~3,000 rpm

failures.part: Catch can smoking at first start-up

parts.part: 1973 El Camino turbo LS roller-ready car (no turbo)
Air-to-air intercooler (came with car, seller paid $100 on Marketplace)
Oil drain line from shop scrap pile

cars.confidence: high for purchase/drivetrain; medium for converter brand and shifter

base_vehicle.model: Mustang (Coyote V8, carbon-fiber interior trim, front-end damage, deployed seat airbags, window louvers)

purchase.note: roughly $5,200 incl. auction fees and shipping, bought via a friend at auction before budget was handed out; ~$2,300 left

engine.family: Ford Coyote (generation not stated); claim it'll hold ~800 hp at least once

power_adder.brand_model: Ty's old, 'pretty much blown up' turbo off his Ranger + his old Ranger wastegates
power_adder.piping: Summit + cheap Chinese/Amazon piping, stainless charge pipe

fuel.system: two pumps in stock hanger, fuel pressure regulator, used injectors
fuel.issue: injectors too short; spacers ordered; ran on stock injectors with base tune

ecu.notes: Nate brought laptop to tune (outside tuner)

reference.fact: Ty's Ranger with the same turbo, wastegates, injectors and pumps ran 9.05 on E85 with a Gen 1 Coyote and 6R80

failures.part: Misfire / loading up, backfire after lift on stock injectors

logistics.fact: Arrived after ~15-16 h tow with multiple flat tires

cars.nickname: possibly 'Lieutenant Dan' (named in later videos; not in this one)

base_vehicle.note: nearly identical to Jackstand's 2017-era high-school car

purchase.note: delivered from Wilson, Oklahoma (~24 h drive by seller); leaves $500 for the week

engine.family: GM LS, iron block (caption 'LS 3pc iron block')

power_adder.brand_model: Nitrous Express (NX) plate, NX Maximizer 3 controller, 3 bottles, jets up to 500 shot available

rear_end.type: stock 240 diff (caption '240 D'), axle breakage expected

tires.desc: on slicks; seeking radials. Got Mickey Thompson ET Street R 255/60R15 via sticker barter at event (counted as free by them, disputed)

weight_lb.claim: ~2,000 lb lighter than the El Camino (~2,800 implied, not stated)

predictions.et: with 200 shot ~5.70s 1/8 mile, possibly low 9s / bottom 9 in 1/4
predictions.sixty_ft: solid 1.30s all day with the Glide

failures.part: Oil pressure sending unit blown through center at first startup; car would not shut off by key/kill switch (coils unplugged)
Water pump seal blew (Amazon LS water pump) -> overheating, steam

gameplay_hooks: sending unit / water pump failures on day zero
